title: Version-information format
explanation: Assumed extractor facts: a version with shape, dirty, changes_suffix, tagged, and tag_appended fields, produced by scripts/version-generate.sh.

cases.original: Derive the version from git state: `date-branch-hash` or `date-branch-tag-hash`.
cases.note: The rule flags a version whose shape is not one of the two named forms; the exact components are the generator's job.
cases.suggestion: Encode the two shapes in the extractor, not the rule.

cases.original: Suffix the hash with `-changes` when the working tree has uncommitted changes.
cases.note: The rule ties the suffix to the dirty flag; it does not enforce the suffix's position.

cases.original: `tag` is appended only when all sources are committed and the current commit is tagged.
cases.note: The rule forbids a tag component on an untagged commit; committed-but-untagged is the extractor's job.
